name: Zettai Junshu ☆ Kozukuri Kyokashou Paradise!! ~Aa, Subarashiki Haramasekai~
original_name: ぜったい遵守☆子作り許可証ぱらだいす!!～嗚呼、素晴らしき孕ま世界～
source:
The year is 21XX, and humanity is still on the verge of destruction.
The birth rate of the human race has decreased, especially the rate of male births.
The current sex ratio of the human race is now 1:107210 male:female, further exacerbating the already overwhelming female majority.
World leaders felt the pressure of this birthrate crisis.
In an attempt to stop this crisis of annihilation, they established the "SEX New Law" and issued each man a "free sexual permit".
Originally disallowing anything but internal ejaculation meant to impregnate, it was eventually decided that men "should not be obligated to insert".
Thus, an "oral permit" and so-called "waste fire permit" (for external ejaculation) were established to help with male stress relief.

Will these new permits make a difference? No one knows for sure...
translation:
时间是21XX年，人类仍处于毁灭的边缘。
人类的出生率下降，尤其是男性出生率。
目前人类的性别比例为1：107210，男性：女性，进一步加剧了本已占压倒性优势的女性比例。
世界领导人感受到了这场出生率危机的压力。
为了阻止这场毁灭性的危机，他们制定了“性新法”，并向每个男人颁发了“自由性许可证”。
最初禁止除了旨在怀孕的内射精之外的任何行为，最终决定男性“不应该有插入的义务”。
因此，“口交许可证”和所谓的“废火许可证”（用于体外射精）应运而生，以帮助男性缓解压力。

这些新的许可证会带来改变吗？没有人确切知道…
